questions.prompt: Write the augmented matrix for the system x + 2y = 5 and 3x - \(y=4\).
questions.answer: The coefficient row for x + 2y = 5 is \((1,2)\) with right side 5. The coefficient row for 3x - \(y=4\) is \((3,-1)\) with right side 4. Therefore the augmented matrix is \(\begin{pmatrix}1&2&5\\3&-1&4\end{pmatrix}\), where the last column is the constants column.

questions.prompt: Write the augmented matrix for 2x - y + \(z=1\), x + 3y = 7, and -x + \(z=0\), using variable order x, y, z.
questions.answer: Use columns for x, y, z, then the constant term. The first equation gives \((2,-1,1,1)\). The second equation has no z term, so it gives \((1,3,0,7)\). The third equation has no y term, so it gives \((-1,0,1,0)\). Therefore the augmented matrix is \(\begin{pmatrix}2&-1&1&1\\1&3&0&7\\-1&0&1&0\end{pmatrix}\).

questions.prompt: Convert the augmented matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}1&-2&3\\0&4&-8\end{pmatrix}\) into a system using variables x and y.
questions.answer: The first two columns are coefficients of x and y, and the last column is the right side. Row 1 gives 1x - 2y = 3. Row 2 gives 0x + 4y = -8, which is 4y = -8. Therefore the system is x - 2y = 3 and 4y = -8.

questions.prompt: Convert \(\begin{pmatrix}2&0&-1&5\\1&3&4&-2\end{pmatrix}\) into equations using variables x, y, z.
questions.answer: There are three coefficient columns and one constants column. Row 1 gives 2x + 0y - \(z=5\), so 2x - \(z=5\). Row 2 gives x + 3y + 4z = -2. Therefore the system is 2x - \(z=5\) and x + 3y + 4z = -2.

questions.prompt: For the augmented matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}1&2&0\\0&0&3\end{pmatrix}\), explain why the represented system is inconsistent.
questions.answer: Using variables x and y, the second row represents 0x + 0y = 3. This says 0 = 3, which is impossible. Because one row gives a contradiction, the system has no solution. Therefore the system is inconsistent.

questions.prompt: For \(\begin{pmatrix}1&0&4\\0&1&-2\end{pmatrix}\), read off the solution to the system in variables x and y.
questions.answer: The first row represents \(x=4\). The second row represents \(y=-2\). Therefore the solution is \(x=4\), \(y=-2\), or as an ordered pair, \((4, -2)\).

questions.prompt: Write the coefficient matrix and constants vector for x - y + 2z = 6 and 3x + \(z=-1\).
questions.answer: Use variable order x, y, z. The coefficient matrix contains only the variable coefficients: \(\begin{pmatrix}1&-1&2\\3&0&1\end{pmatrix}\). The constants vector contains the right sides: \(\begin{pmatrix}6\\-1\end{pmatrix}\). The zero in the coefficient matrix appears because the second equation has no y term.

questions.prompt: A system has coefficient matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{pmatrix}\) and constants vector \(\begin{pmatrix}5\\6\end{pmatrix}\). Write its augmented matrix.
questions.answer: The augmented matrix appends the constants vector as the final column of the coefficient matrix. Row 1 becomes \((1,2,5)\). Row 2 becomes \((3,4,6)\). Therefore the augmented matrix is \(\begin{pmatrix}1&2&5\\3&4&6\end{pmatrix}\).

questions.prompt: Using variables x, y, z, identify the missing entry a in \(\begin{pmatrix}1&a&2&4\end{pmatrix}\) if the row represents x - 3y + 2z = 4.
questions.answer: The augmented row lists coefficients of x, y, z, followed by the right side. The coefficient of y in x - 3y + 2z = 4 is -3. Therefore \(a=-3\).

questions.prompt: A learner writes the augmented matrix for x + \(y=2\) and x - \(y=0\) as \(\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\\2&0\end{pmatrix}\). Diagnose the error.
questions.answer: The learner has placed the constants as a separate row. In an augmented matrix, each equation is one row, and the constants form the final column. The correct rows are \((1,1,2)\) and \((1,-1,0)\). Therefore the correct augmented matrix is \(\begin{pmatrix}1&1&2\\1&-1&0\end{pmatrix}\).
